text:
Claire (CSM): @Zoe quick check-in: onboarding looks steady but we saw a rising p95 on the payments-chat route this week. Renewal discussion in 4 weeks, want to propose low-risk perf options. Any constraints on model swaps, quant builds, or routing experiments?

Zoe (GalaxyFi): Were on Dedicated in eu-west-2. Compliance needs a digest for any new model binary, but otherwise flexible. Majority of traffic is short confirmations (~62%) and medium explanations (~28%). We can try canaries but no change to reserved slot size until renewal.

Hector (Solutions Eng): Good candidates: 1) route short confirmations to a q4 quantized assistant-lite, 2) enable prefix KV cache for repeated payment templates, 3) reduce max_batch_latency for medium gens. Quick example rules we can stage:
```yaml
routes:
  - match: {intent: "confirm", tokens: "<120"}
    target: redwood/assistant-lite-1.3b-q4
  - match: {intent: "explain", tokens: "120-600"}
    target: redwood/assistant-medium-4b
inference:
  batching:
    max_batch_latency_ms: 10
cache:
  prefix_kv: true
  ttl_seconds: 3600
```

Anya (Product): Suggest a cautious canary: 1% -> 5% over 3h with monitors p95, error_rate, and a 30-sample quality smoke test. Auto-rollback if p95 increases >18% or quality fails. Also add a token-usage probe for renewal numbers.

Zoe (GalaxyFi): 1%->5% OK. Compliance will need the binary digest; we can sign off within 48h. Avoid canary during nightly settlements at 23:00 UTC.

Hector (Solutions Eng): Canary snippet:
```json
{"canary":{"start_pct":1,"ramp_to":5,"ramp_hours":3},"rollback":{"p95_increase_pct":18,"quality_failures":1}}
```
Also prep playbook: `redwood canary start --route payments-chat --artifact assistant-lite-q4` and rollback: `redwood canary abort --route payments-chat`.

ops-bot: Reminder: Dedicated maintenance window in eu-west-2 at 2001120000; rollouts paused during the window.

Claire (CSM): Action items: Hector to build vetted q4 artifact and push canary config; Anya to add 30 golden prompts and token probes; Zoe to confirm compliance window. I'll schedule a 30-min enablement call Wed 10:00 CET.

Zoe (GalaxyFi): Thanks. If we can hit ~15-20% p95 reduction during peak and ~12-18% token savings without quality regression that makes renewal talks much easier.

Claire (CSM): Noted for renewal brief. Goals: p95 down 15-20% at peak, tokens down ~15%, no noticeable quality loss. :white_check_mark:
